title: Systems Engineer
description:
**Job Description**

Responsible for the administration, availability and security of the group's Windows server infrastructure, with primary focus on Active Directory, Hyper-V, Windows Server OS, Backup & Recovery and server/storage hardware, and secondary support for VMware, Linux and Azure, in a 24x7 healthcare environment.

**Primary Responsibilities :**

Active Directory & Identity

•Administer multi-site AD DS: domain controllers, replication, sites, FSMO roles, trusts, DNS and DHCP.

•Design and troubleshoot Group Policy; manage users, groups, service accounts and OUs with least privilege.

•Harden AD (privileged groups, Kerberos/NTLM, LAPS, audit policies) and support Entra Connect / hybrid identity.

Hyper-V Virtualisation

•Build and maintain Hyper-V hosts and Failover Clusters (CSV, live migration, virtual networking) via WAC/SCVMM.

•Provision and size VMs, monitor capacity, and support VMware-to-Hyper-V migration activities.

Windows Server OS

•Install, harden and support Windows Server 2016–2025, including File/DFS, IIS, RDS, WSUS and clustering roles.

•Run the OS patching cycle with pre/post checks; remediate vulnerabilities (CVEs) against security baselines.

•Troubleshoot OS and performance issues; automate routine tasks and reports with PowerShell.

Backup & Recovery

•Administer enterprise backup (Veeam preferred): jobs, retention, repositories, immutable/offsite and cloud copies.

•Perform restore tests and DR drills, protect SQL/file/M365 workloads, resolve failures and report backup status.

Server & Storage Hardware

•Troubleshoot server hardware (CPU, memory, disks, RAID, PSU, NICs) using iLO/iDRAC, IML and AHS logs.

•Support SAN/NAS storage (LUNs, multipathing, FC/iSCSI, disk/controller faults); log OEM cases, apply firmware and coordinate part replacements.

**SECONDARY RESPONSIBILITIES**

•VMware vSphere: support ESXi/vCenter operations (VMs, snapshots, HA/DRS) and workload migration off VMware.

•Linux: basic-to-intermediate administration of RHEL, Ubuntu and AlmaLinux (users, services, storage, patching).

•Azure: support IaaS VMs, VNets/NSGs, storage, Azure Backup and Site Recovery within RBAC and governance standards.

GENERAL

•Handle incidents, requests and changes in ServiceDesk Plus within SLA, following ITIL processes.

•Maintain documentation (HLD/LLD, SOPs, runbooks, CMDB); coordinate with vendors; support audits and on-call.

**QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS**

•Bachelor's degree in IT/Computer Science or equivalent

•Proven hands-on experience with AD/GPO, Hyper-V clustering, Windows Server, enterprise backup and server/storage hardware troubleshooting.

•Working knowledge of PowerShell; exposure to VMware, Linux and Azure. Healthcare/24x7 experience is an advantage.

•Preferred certifications: AZ-800/801, AZ-104, VMCE, VCP-DCV, RHCSA, ITIL 4 Foundation.

•Strong troubleshooting, clear English communication, ownership and ability to work under pressure.

**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS**

SLA compliance for tickets · Backup success and restore test results · Patch compliance · Service uptime · Documentation/CMDB accuracy.

**Experience :**

5 - 8 years in Windows server / data center infrastructure.

Pay: ₹75,000.00 - ₹85,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Experience:

* Windows server / data center infrastructure: 5 years (Required)

Work Location: In person

title: Electronic Systems Engineer
description:
**Posting Title:** Electronic Systems Engineer

**Industry:** Engineering

**Salary:** Rs.18,000 INR

**Work Experience:** 0–1 year

-

**Summary**

We are seeking motivated and capable applicants who have completed, or are currently pursuing, a course involving **PCB design**, such as a **B.Tech in Electronics/Electronic Engineering**, or a relevant **standalone PCB or electronic design course**. Candidates with strong **practical, hands-on experience** in PCB design and electronic systems are also encouraged to apply, provided they meet the other requirements and align with our organizational culture as outlined above.

The role requires an **Electronic Systems Engineer** who will be responsible for designing printed circuit boards (PCBs) for a wide range of applications, as well as assembling, testing, and validating these designs. This position goes beyond simply implementing circuits based on an existing Bill of Materials (BOM) or part list. You will play an active role in shaping design decisions by evaluating project requirements and determining appropriate features, components, and system architectures.

As part of this role, you will be encouraged to contribute ideas at every level of the design process—from high-level system architecture to detailed, low-level circuit design. You will work within a structured framework of standards and procedures to ensure consistency, quality, and safety, and in some cases, you may also contribute to developing new standards or improving existing ones. The knowledge gained through your work will not only enhance your own expertise but will also be shared across the team to promote collective growth and continuous improvement.

  

**Responsibilities and Duties**
-------------------------------

* Analyze problem statements, project requirements, or client briefs and collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to determine optimal design approaches, component selections, and system configurations.
* Make informed design decisions that balance performance, reliability, manufacturability, cost, and scalability.
* Identify, recommend, and implement design changes or enhancements to improve system performance, efficiency, and technical capabilities.
* Design, review, assemble, test, debug, and update electronic systems, PCBs, components, equipment, and associated software where applicable.
* Conduct inspections and validation testing to ensure designs meet functional requirements, safety standards, and quality benchmarks.
* Coordinate and communicate with vendors, suppliers, and external partners to obtain technical documentation, components, materials, and design support as required.
* Ensure strict adherence to internal **Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)** related to design, safety, and quality, while proactively suggesting improvements or updates to these procedures when necessary.
* Stay current with advancements in electronic systems and PCB design, including emerging technologies, industry trends, tools, standards, and best practices.
* Document design decisions, test results, and process improvements clearly to support knowledge sharing and future reference.
* Uphold and promote the company’s culture of **quality, safety, accountability, and continuous learning** in all professional activities and deliverables.

  
  
  

### **Benefits**

* Weekends off, except when project requirements demand flexibility.
* Official company SIM provided for work-related communication.
* Festivity bonus for Christmas,Onam, and Vishu/Easter, project start and closing bonus, performance bonus (All bonuses are at the sole discretion of the Employer).
* Team building activities and company events.
* Conveyance for official purpose.
* 12 days casual leave, 12 days sick leave, 8 days wellness leaves.

  
BTech/Diploma
